meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 当用户发来带本地路径的文档附件时，Claude 会在容器内将 Word、PPT、Excel、PDF 等文件转换成 Markdown 文件，再读取其内容回答用户，不会把文件上传到外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当消息中给出本地附件路径，且文件是支持转换的文档格式（如 Word、PDF、CSV 等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我转换这个电子表格 /tmp/数据.csv，注意说明格式丢失情况。
say.note: Claude 会转换并提示可能的格式损失。

howto.what_en: When the user provides a local attachment path, Claude converts documents (Word, PPT, Excel, PDF, etc.) to Markdown inside its container and reads the output, without uploading to external services.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message includes a local attachment path for a supported document format such as Word, PDF, or CSV.

say_en.text: Convert /workspace/inbox/msg/report.docx to Markdown and summarize the key points.
say_en.note: Claude converts locally and reads the content.

say_en.text: Is /data/file.pdf a scanned or image-only PDF? If so, explain that it can't be converted.
say_en.note: Claude checks and reports whether it is supported.

say_en.text: Convert this spreadsheet /tmp/data.csv and note any formatting loss.
say_en.note: Claude converts and mentions potential formatting issues.
